description: This file defines the Perl package Git::IndexInfo, which manages index information for Git objects, including methods for creating new index info objects, removing entries, updating entries, and cleanup.

classes.name: Git::IndexInfo
classes.description: A class representing Git index information, handling operations such as adding and removing index entries.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new Git::IndexInfo object, setting up pipes and determining hash algorithm.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an index entry for a specified path, writing the removal info to the index.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Adds or updates an index entry with specified mode, hash, and path.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor that closes the pipe connections.
